title: 第一卷 第15章 摸够了没有第一卷 第16章 下不为例
slug: 逆主马奴我以阴阳证大道
lines: 院子里。
王龙全身灵力缓缓运转，看着秦明岚，沉声道。
“老奴在教大小姐之前，大小姐可以先亲自感受一下，这门剑诀的威力。”
秦明岚激动地点点头。
“没问题，来吧，本小姐准备好了！”
在远处观战跟亲自感受是完全不一样的。
秦明岚此刻彻底相信王龙要教自己剑诀。
不知不觉间她对王龙的态度变好了许多，她自己都没有察觉。
王龙点点头，伸出手，摊开掌心。
识海中，那柄诛仙剑胚微微震动，一缕锐利的剑气从中分离，顺着经脉流转到掌心。
王龙睁开眼，掌心朝上，五指缓缓张开。
一缕无形无质的剑气从他掌心逸出，虽然微弱，却带着一股让人脊背发凉的锋锐之意。
剑气在空气中凝聚，虽然看不见，却能清晰地感觉到它的存在。
像一柄无形的利剑，悬在两人之间。
秦明岚的瞳孔瞬间收缩。
她感觉到了。
那股锋锐之意，比方才在比武场上还要清晰，还要纯粹。
那不是普通的剑气。
而是一种更高层次的力量。
她下意识后退了半步，随即又停住，杏眼中满是震惊。
“老东……王龙，这就是……”
“太虚破妄剑气。”
王龙笑着点点头，五指合拢，将剑气收回体内。
“不知道这门剑诀值不值得大小姐喊一声师父？”
秦明岚沉默了。
她盯着王龙的掌心，目光闪烁，像是在回味方才那股锋锐之意。
秦明岚在侯府的府库种挑选过各式各样的灵诀，眼界很高。
她能感觉的出来，王龙的《太虚破妄剑诀》超越了自己所见过的所有灵诀。
内心天人交战了好一会儿，她缓缓抬起头，看着王龙，心中已然有了决定！
亲也亲了，喊师父能有什么？！
秦明岚嘴唇动了动，却没有发出声音。
王龙也不催促，只是安静地站着，微微佝偻着背，一副谦卑模样。
秦明岚深吸一口气，她看着王龙，嘴唇微微张开。
第一个字刚出口，她的脸就涨得通红。
王龙看着她这幅可爱的模样，心中觉得觉得好有意思。
这小祖宗，让她喊一声师父，比杀了她还难受。
content_en:
yard.
Wang Long's spiritual energy circulated slowly throughout his body, he looked at Qin Minglan and said in a deep voice.
"Before I teach the young lady, the young lady can first feel the power of this sword art for herself."
Qin Minglan nodded excitedly.
"No problem, come on, I'm ready!"
Watching a game from a distance is completely different from experiencing it in person.
At this moment, Qin Minglan completely believed that Wang Long wanted to teach him the sword technique.
Unknowingly, her attitude towards Wang Lung changed a lot, and she didn't even notice it.
Wang Long nodded, stretched out his hand, and spread his palms.
In the sea of ​​consciousness, the embryo of the Immortal Killing Sword shook slightly, and a sharp sword energy separated from it, flowing along the meridians to the palm of the hand.
Wang Long opened his eyes, turned his palms upward, and slowly opened his fingers.
A wisp of invisible sword energy escaped from his palm. Although it was weak, it carried a sharpness that sent chills down the spine.
The sword energy condensed in the air, and although it was invisible, its existence could be clearly felt.
Like an invisible sword, hanging between the two.
Qin Minglan's pupils shrank instantly.
She felt it.
That sharpness was clearer and purer than it was on the martial arts field just now.
That was no ordinary sword energy.
But a higher level of power.
She subconsciously took a half step back, then stopped again, her almond-shaped eyes full of shock.
"Old Dong...Wang Long, this is..."
"Taixu breaks the sword energy."
Wang Long smiled and nodded, clasping his fingers together and taking the sword energy back into his body.
"I wonder if this sword art is worth calling me Master?"
Qin Minglan was silent.
She stared at Wang Long's palm, her eyes flickering, as if she was recalling the sharpness just now.
Qin Minglan has selected various spiritual techniques in the treasury of the Hou Mansion, and has a very high vision.
She could feel that Wang Long's "Taixu Breaking the Illusion Sword Jue" surpassed all the spiritual techniques she had ever seen.
The inner world was fighting for a while. She slowly raised her head and looked at Wang Long. She already had a decision in her heart!
Even if you kiss me, what can you get by calling me master? !
Qin Minglan's lips moved, but no sound came out.
Wang Lung didn't urge him, he just stood quietly, with his back slightly stooped, looking humble.
Qin Minglan took a deep breath. She looked at Wang Long and opened her lips slightly.
"Teacher..."
As soon as the first word came out of her mouth, her face turned red.
Wang Long looked at her cute appearance and felt that it was so interesting.
This little ancestor, asking her to call her master would be more uncomfortable than killing her.
